svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make three. Cut 1,000 mm of 48.3 x 3.2 mm galvanized pipe with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one end threaded 1.5 in (have the merchant cut and thread it).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw the 1.5 in malleable-iron end cap onto the threaded end with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thread sealant, hand tight plus a quarter turn with a pipe wrench.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File the other (top) end square and deburr inside and out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint a ground mark round the pipe 200 mm below the top; the pipe

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: goes into the ground up to this mark (800 mm buried).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Touch up cut galvanizing with zinc-rich paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Do not drill the head screw holes yet: they are drilled through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the head's socket at assembly so they line up (step 6).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the cap keeps grout and water out of the bottom; the stand

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube stands on the cap's floor inside the pipe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: blow down the pipe; no light or air through the cap.
